memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from consulting multiple independent expert tools and only committing to a side-specific answer when complementary tools agree. metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "right lung opacity", "B": "left lung opacity"}
metadata.retrieval_focus: Localizing and comparing findings across left and right sides in medical images, using spatial orientation to distinguish laterality when identifying abnormalities.
